from common import *
import gc,math,pickle

def main():
 save_source(__file__)
 import numpy as np
 import pandas as pd
 from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
 from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import _validate_metadata
 state=read(PROGRESS);native=harness('check')
 assert state['status']=='evaluation_complete_awaiting_review'
 assert len(state['jobs'])==20 and all(j['status']=='succeeded' for j in state['jobs'])
 assert {(j['variant'],j['seed']) for j in state['jobs']}=={(v,s) for v in VARIANTS for s in SEEDS}
 assert set(native['jobs'])=={j['job_id'] for j in state['jobs']}
 assert all(state['scientific_candidates'][v]['status']=='completed' for v in VARIANTS)
 check(state['source_amendment']);check(state['prepared_inputs'])
 prepared=read(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json');params=read(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json')['parameters']
 preflight=read(BASE/'docs/preflight-verification.json')
 assert preflight['sum_same_ordered_H20_rows'] and preflight['skip_missing_without_count_scaling']
 models=[];inputs=[]
 for job in state['jobs']:
  assert native['jobs'][job['job_id']]['outcome']=='succeeded'
  for fp in native['jobs'][job['job_id']]['evidence']:check(fp)
  r=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{job["job_id"]}.json')
  for k in ['model','input_receipt','selected_valid_heads']:check(r[k])
  inp=read(ROOT/r['input_receipt']['path']);expected=prepared['expectations'][job['variant']]
  control=read(PRIOR/'docs'/f'inputs-h{HORIZONS[job["variant"]]}.json')
  assert inp['label_receipt']==prepared['variants'][job['variant']]['new']
  check(inp['label_receipt'])
  assert inp['training']['index_sha256']==expected['index_sha256']==control['training']['index_sha256']
  assert inp['feature_array_sha256']==expected['feature_array_sha256']==control['feature_array_sha256']
  assert inp['training']['shape']==[expected['rows'],165]
  assert inp['validation']==control['valid_signature'] and inp['tradable']==control['tradable_signature']
  assert inp['parameters']==params
  inputs.append((job['variant'],inp))
  es=r['early_stopping'][0];scores=np.asarray(es['metric_history'])
  assert es['es_metric']=='top5_h5_net_ann' and es['valid_days']==1448
  assert es['early_stopping_rounds']==50 and es['num_boost_round']==200
  assert np.isfinite(scores).all() and len(scores)==len(r['rounds'])==len(r['tie_diagnostics'])
  assert es['best_iteration']==int(scores.argmax())+1 and es['best_score']==float(scores.max())
  assert len(scores)==min(200,es['best_iteration']+50)
  with (ROOT/r['model']['path']).open('rb') as f:model=pickle.load(f)
  assert model.model.best_iteration==es['best_iteration'] and model.model.num_feature()==164
  assert model.params==r['parameters'] and model.params['seed']==job['seed']
  for k,val in params.items():
   if k not in ['num_boost_round','early_stopping_rounds']:assert model.params[k]==val
  del model;gc.collect()
  models.append({'job_id':job['job_id'],'model':r['model'],'rows':expected['rows'],'best_iteration':es['best_iteration'],'observed_rounds':len(scores)})
 for v in VARIANTS:
  for k in ['weights_sha256','label_values_sha256']:
   assert len({i[k] for n,i in inputs if n==v})==1
 assert len({i['weights_sha256'] for n,i in inputs if n.startswith('sum20')})==1
 control_index=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/'backtest/result/20261105_horizon_p50/h20/horizonp50_20261105_h20_s42_pred.pkl').index
 verified=[]
 for v in VARIANTS:
  proof_path=BASE/'docs'/f'predictions-{v}-new.json';proof=read(proof_path)
  receipt=state['scientific_candidates'][v]['treatments']['new']
  check(receipt['evaluation']);check(receipt['prediction_proof'])
  assert receipt['prediction_proof']==fingerprint(proof_path)
  assert [x['seed'] for x in proof['components']]==SEEDS
  predictions=[]
  for item in proof['components']:
   for k in ['model','prediction','training']:check(item[k])
   job=next(j for j in state['jobs'] if j['variant']==v and j['seed']==item['seed'])
   assert item['training']==job['evidence']
   assert item['model']==read(ROOT/item['training']['path'])['model']
   assert item['session']==job['session']
   p=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/item['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0]
   assert p.index.is_unique and p.index.equals(control_index) and np.isfinite(p.to_numpy()).all()
   predictions.append(p)
  check(proof['ensemble']);actual=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/proof['ensemble']['path']).iloc[:,0]
  blend=blend_score_series(predictions)
  assert actual.index.equals(blend.index) and np.array_equal(actual.to_numpy(),blend.to_numpy(),equal_nan=True)
  result=read(ROOT/receipt['evaluation']['path']);check(result['diagnostic_heads'])
  assert result['label_target_study']['prediction_proof']==fingerprint(proof_path)
  assert result['label_target_study']['horizon']==HORIZONS[v]
  assert result['label_target_study']['variant']==v
  assert [x['session'] for x in result['sessions']]==[x['session'] for x in proof['components']]
  assert result['data_version']=='2026-11-03' and result['label_window_cutoff']['h5']=='2026-07-23'
  e=result['pools']['all']['ensemble']
  assert e['head']['3']['5']['n_days']==1448 and math.isfinite(e['h5']['rank_ic_mean'])
  assert set(e['head_years'])=={str(y) for y in range(2020,2027)}
  assert {r:e['head_regimes'][r]['3']['5']['n_days'] for r in ['D','F','T']}=={'D':1010,'F':136,'T':302}
  for year in range(2020,2027):
   inp=read(BASE/'docs'/f'inference-input-{year}.json')
   assert inp['formal_DK_I'] and inp['control_prediction_exact']
   ip=read(BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{v}-{year}.json');check(ip['input'])
   for item in ip['predictions']:check(item['prediction_part'])
  verified.append({'variant':v,'rows':len(actual),'ensemble_recomputed_exact':True,'prediction_proof':fingerprint(proof_path),'evaluation':receipt['evaluation']})
  del predictions,p,actual,blend;gc.collect()
  print('Verified',v,flush=True)
 controls=read(BASE/'docs/control-evaluation-verification.json')
 assert len(controls['controls'])==5 and all(c['exact_metric_match'] for c in controls['controls'])
 for fp in controls['artifacts']:check(fp)
 _validate_metadata(ROOT,BASE/'metadata.json',read(BASE/'metadata.json'),'model')
 replay=read(BASE/'docs/early-stopping-replay.json');assert replay['status']=='complete' and replay['successful_fit_count']==20
 write(BASE/'docs/final-numerical-verification.json',{'at':time.time(),'status':'complete','models':models,'prediction_groups':verified,
  'actual_fits':20,'technical_retries':0,'prior_fits':176,'cumulative_fits':196,'native_ledger_matches':True,
  'four_target_rows_features_validation_masks_parameters_verified':True,'weights_and_labels_identical_across_each_five_seed_group':True,
  'same_original_H20_rows_for_sum':True,'five_controls_match_canonical_metrics':True,'annual_formal_inference_control_exact':True,
  'source_amendment':state['source_amendment'],'preflight':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/preflight-verification.json'),'replay':fingerprint(BASE/'docs/early-stopping-replay.json'),
  'limits':'Historical selection window. No independent OOS. Verifies saved input/model identities and exact four-ensemble arithmetic; independent selected-return recomputation is separately recorded in review audits.'})
 print('Verified all20 models, all4 exact ensembles and native ledger.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
